days.heading: a winner
days.criterion: the day the architect named for this slot. It QUALIFIES on the ledger's own record: the trade was taken, it reached the target, it made money, it was not a gap entry, and it falls inside the last three months of the run
days.bias_detail: Rule 3: P.high 74150 broken first (1-min high 74190); C.close 73835 >= bodyMin 73800 -> bullish

days.heading: a stop-out
days.criterion: a stop-out from the last day the machine walked, chosen so it is a TYPICAL one and not a freak: of that day's stop-outs -- all of them, gap entries included -- the one whose distance from entry to stop is nearest the middle distance of all the run's trades. Ties go to the stock this run traded most often, and if that ties too, to the first stock alphabetically

days.heading: a gap day
days.criterion: the day the architect named for this slot, and it falls on the LAST DAY of the ten years that any stock gapped in. It QUALIFIES: the ledger records it as a gap entry. It was not the only gap entry that day: 2 stocks gapped in on it (INDUSINDBK at 12:45, against this one at 12:30), so this is one of them and not a last of anything

days.heading: a day the 11:15 candle closed exactly ON the POC
days.criterion: the most recent day in the whole run where the 11:15 candle closed at exactly the POC price -- your Round-3 answer A, the one where the first candle only picks the side. Where more than one stock did that on the same day, the one that went on to take a trade is shown, because a day with no trade cannot show the rest of the rule; then the stock this run traded most often, and then the last one alphabetically

days.heading: a day with no trade at all
days.criterion: a day from the last day the machine walked where no NEW rule fired on the two daily candles -- either an inside bar, which is your rule 1 and says the bias does not change, or nothing fitting at all -- so the machine kept the bias it already had, and no trade followed. Ties go to the stock this run traded most often, and then to the last one alphabetically
days.bias_detail: inside bar: C.high 102020 <= P.high 102200 and C.low 101200 >= P.low 100830

days.heading: the day that settles one open question
days.criterion: a day where the two possible ways of rounding the profile's tick count draw a DIFFERENT number of rows -- so counting the rows on your own chart settles a question the specification still calls provisional. Of the days in the span's last calendar year where that happens, this is one of the days with the widest gap between the two row counts and with the POC itself moving. 2 days tie on both of those (ZYDUSLIFE on Wednesday 11 March 2026) -- this one is shown because it also TOOK A TRADE, and a day with no trade cannot show the rest of the rule
